characters.biography: The 22-year-old British male model is an extremely perfect fit for street-style high-fashion shoots. He has a habit of whistling softly while waiting for his turn on set, and always spends his leisure time on the terrace of his apartment tending to the dozen or so ornamental pigeons he keeps.
